- Thu Sep 2: 13:00–16:00 PDT
- Fri Sep 3: 10:00–15:00 PDT

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

1) SOC 2 controls & evidence handoff — 45 minutes
2) Pen test scope + Q&A (technical deep-dive) — 30 minutes

Suggested back-to-back slots (all PDT):
- Thu Sep 2: 13:30–14:15 (controls) then 14:20–14:50 (pen Q&A)
- Fri Sep 3: 11:00–11:45 then 11:50–12:20

Please tell us which slot you prefer and which internal folks will join each session (controls vs pen Q&A). We'll prepare a short controls slide deck and a shared Drive folder for evidence upload prior to the controls session.

Also: if you could confirm whether the pen test team will want SSH/host-level access or only API endpoints, we can line up the right engineer.

Best,
